## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Japanese and English content state the same facts, dates, and links, or this change does not affect translated content.
- [ ] Public claims and external links were checked against approved sources.
- [ ] No secrets, private information, unpublished client details, or unapproved third-party material are included.
- [ ] Headings, link text, image alternatives, focus, and keyboard use were checked where relevant.
- [ ] Local checks were run; list their results below. If unavailable, explain why.
- [ ] Deployment and rollback impact were considered.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks actually performed and their results.

## Screenshots

For visible changes, add before and after screenshots or explain why they are unavailable.
